import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if j != i:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i][j - 1]
            if i != 0:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j]
            dp[i][j] %= MOD

    ans = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            if (i + j) & 1:
                ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
